state_machine.description: Valid Target and Reset FALSE. Count updates on rising edge, saturated to Target; Complete reflects Count >= Target.
Valid Target and Reset TRUE. Count forced to 0 and Complete forced FALSE.
Target outside 1..20. Error TRUE, Count 0, Complete FALSE.

timer_plan.note: No timer function blocks are required. All behavior is scan/invocation based.

priorities: Safety first: validate Target exactly. Invalid Target (<1 or >20) forces Error=TRUE, Count=0, Complete=FALSE and overrides Reset and counting.
Reset next: with valid Target, Reset=TRUE forces Count=0 and Complete=FALSE; rising edges are not counted during Reset.
Edge memory is unconditional: previous_pulse samples PartPulse on every scan, including invalid Target, Reset, and Error conditions.
Normal counting last: only when Target is valid and Reset=FALSE, Count=min(previous Count + rising_edge, Target); Complete follows Count>=Target.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Sample PartPulse, Reset, and Target once into scan-local inputs.
rise := PartPulse AND NOT previous_pulse, using the retained previous_pulse value from before this scan.
previous_pulse := PartPulse immediately after rise is computed; this update executes on every scan, including Invalid and Reset scans.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority & state transitions
actions: If invalid: BatchState_next := INVALID; next_Count := 0; next_Complete := FALSE; next_Error := TRUE.
Else if Reset: BatchState_next := RESETTING; next_Count := 0; next_Complete := FALSE; next_Error := FALSE.
Else: BatchState_next := COUNTING; next_Count := min(Count + (rise ? 1 : 0), Target); next_Complete := (next_Count >= Target); next_Error := FALSE.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No timer FB calls are needed in this design.
